what: Once, when the photo cell’s top edge reaches 71% of the screen height — a vertical gradient mask (dark at the top 0~25%, transparent below 65%) at 5.6× the cell size hangs at the bottom, then moves upward over 2.5s so the photo softly seeps in from the top (transparent → opaque during the first 20%)

options.start: Height at which it turns on (ratio from top of screen), default .714 — original ‹Scroll > Cell top − window + window/3.5

from.where: shared.js .c-scroll-mask (almost all photo cells — fade_mask image · mask-size auto 560% → 500% · right bottom → center 0% · 2.5s)

note: The original overlay is a PNG image (4000px square, strong in the top 25% fading to 65% transparent, slightly lighter at the left and right edges), so it was rewritten as a linear-gradient with the same vertical proportions. The lighter side edges were dropped
